summary: The Helion config pick builds CaseKey {intermediate 2048, numtokens 256} and reads both values back, with the sorted compact JSON form.
Only asserts FP4 GEMM numerics (assert_close against a dequantized matmul). The control-path scenario (quant x2, then cutlass_scaled_fp4_mm) passes.
Every assertion is tensor numerics of the ReplaySSM kernel against PyTorch references. The model also has no ReplaySSM entity.

Only asserts INT8 output and scale numerics against ref_dynamic_per_token_quant, plus an opcheck. The control-path scenario passes: no scale gives dynamic per-token, symmetric gives no azp, and _C::dynamic_scaled_int8_quant is called.

support-torch-compile.call ignores the module's do_not_compile (decorators.py:528), so the @ignore_torch_compile class B is dispatched as compiled. Its compiled flag is component-wide rather than per module (decorators.py:415), so C never recompiles.
